about_the_game:
Band Mates is an innovative musical playground that turns your controller into a full band. Jam, experiment, and create music in ways you never thought possible - solo or with friends!

Sketch out quick musical sketches or build fully fleshed-out songs. There are no wrong paths in Band Mates—just the freedom to play, customize, and see where your creativity takes you. Beginners will love how easy it is to be musical, while experienced creators will enjoy the deeper editing options. Every time you play you'll be handed a new unique starting palette to work with - it's always quick to find inspiration in Band Mates!

Be inspired by your friends as you bounce ideas back and forth. And when you land on something that feels just right, share it with your Steam community, then see how others "remix" and take your music in totally new directions.

Band Mates combines the best of two worlds: video games and music. With just a controller in hand, making music has never been this fun or effortless. The controls are easy to pick up and satisfying to master, opening the door to endless creative possibilities.

At its heart, Band Mates is about expression, connection, and the simple joy of making music!

short_description: Band Mates is a chill music-making game that provides a quick and intuitive sonic playground to jam out solo or with friends. A plethora of groovy sounds, funky beats, and vibrant fx allow for all styles of music. Let your creativity guide you and discover the joy of making music!
